states.web: A segment is active when currentTime is inside its range (text-action-ink), past when after it (muted foreground), and upcoming otherwise (muted at 60%); with onSeek, hover moves it to the foreground colour and the cursor becomes a pointer, without it the cursor is default. Blank segments are not drawn.

disabled.web: There is no disabled state: a transcript without onSeek is read-only, which is shown by the default cursor and the absence of a hover colour. The segment buttons are not disabled in that case, so they remain focusable.

interaction.web: Pressing a segment calls onSeek with its startSecond and then the segment's own onClick. The component never changes its own time on a press: the caller moves currentTime, typically from an audio element's timeupdate. useControllableState holds the time, with onSeek as its change callback.

semantics.web: Each segment is a type=button element named by its word; active, past and upcoming are conveyed by colour only plus data-active, with no aria-current, so the caller should expose the playback position elsewhere. The container takes aria props such as aria-live, which the workspace composer sets to polite for live dictation.
